title: The One-Time Purchase and the Bundle
lessons: The player notices the packaging looks different on the shelf and learns it is Liquid I.V.'s first redesign since Unilever bought the company.
The player already knows which formulas they like and sees a discounted bundle combining two seasonal products.

text: Same aisle as always. The Liquid I.V. bag looks different, and you walked past it once before you noticed.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: New bag? I barely spotted you.

entry-first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Same spot, new bag. New logo, bigger type, and the fruit finally gets to be on the front instead of hiding behind the nutrition panel. I've been waiting a decade to look like this.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So you got prettier.

entry-first-4.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: I got noticed. You walked past me once. It's the first time I've changed anything about how I look since Unilever bought me, and it's because of that half second right there.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: That's a lot of pressure for one glance at an endcap.

entry-first-6.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: It's the whole job on this aisle. What's inside the bag hasn't moved an inch.

choice-first.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Okay, you've circled back. Grab me or don't.

choices.text: It does catch the eye. I'll grab one.
A new logo doesn't change what's in the packet.
A corporate parent redesigning you a decade in makes me trust you less, not more.

first-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Good. Get me past the shelf and I'll do the part that actually matters.

first-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: You're right. It doesn't. The formula didn't need a new bag. Your attention did. That's on me, not you.

first-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Fair. If somebody I knew changed everything about how they looked after getting bought, I'd want to check it was still them too. Read the back. It's the same back.
You know which two formulas you like. There's a sticker on the shelf: both seasonal flavors, together, a few dollars less than buying them separately.

entry-return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Two seasonal flavors, one price, slightly less than both.

entry-return-2.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're very pleased with the word bundle.

entry-return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: I like a packed bag.

entry-return-4.speaker: PLAYER
text: The discount only helps if I wanted both.

entry-return-5.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Yep. Cheaper is still more. I'm not going to argue that one.

choice-return.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: So did you want both, or did the sticker want you to want both?

choices.text: I'd buy the bundle if I wanted both anyway.
A discount can get me to buy more than I planned.
I don't need a pantry full of hydration packets.

return-1.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then it's a good deal, and it's only a good deal because of that. Grab it.

return-2.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: It can. Saving money and spending more can be the same cart. I've watched it happen from the shelf.

return-3.speaker: LIQUID I.V.
text: Then one bag. Or none. Your cabinet doesn't need to become my back room.
